compliance.requirement: Proposer must clearly define the proposed deployment model, including licensing and hosting location.
compliance.evidence: NimbusCourt is offered as SaaS on AWS GovCloud and can be deployed on-premise with perpetual licenses, and the licensing and hosting location are clearly defined.

compliance.requirement: Proposer must store and process County data within the continental United States.
compliance.evidence: NimbusCourt stores and processes all customer data only within the continental United States, as stated in K1 and K2.

compliance.requirement: Proposer must have and follow a disaster recovery plan.
compliance.evidence: Nimbus maintains a documented disaster recovery plan that is tested twice a year.

compliance.requirement: Proposer must back up all County data daily to an offsite hardened facility if applicable.
compliance.evidence: Nimbus backs up all customer data daily and replicates backups to a separate, hardened offsite facility (AWS GovCloud US-West).

compliance.requirement: Contractor must provide software upgrades at no cost to the County.
compliance.evidence: Nimbus provides all new versions and upgrades of NimbusCourt at no additional cost to customers with an active SaaS subscription or maintenance agreement.

compliance.requirement: Contractor must meet with the County’s Project Manager quarterly for performance reviews.
compliance.evidence: The requirement is met with a different frequency; Nimbus holds quarterly business reviews, while the RFP requires quarterly meetings.

compliance.requirement: Contractor must ensure all personnel possess necessary skills, experience, and knowledge to perform assigned duties.
compliance.evidence: The company has a Business Process and Training Lead with 8 years of court business process optimisation and training experience, and a structured testing and training methodology.

compliance.requirement: Proposer must maintain detailed records of services rendered for three years.
compliance.evidence: Nimbus keeps project and billing records for 7 years after final payment, which exceeds the RFP requirement of three years.

compliance.requirement: Proposer must develop and provide a detailed project management plan including objectives, deliverables, milestones, project schedule, and resource management processes.
compliance.evidence: Nimbus provides a Project Management Plan as part of every project, which includes objectives, deliverables, milestones, schedule, and resource management processes.

compliance.requirement: Proposer must provide a data conversion plan, including strategies for legacy case data management.
compliance.evidence: Nimbus provides a Data Conversion Plan as part of their Project Management Deliverables.

compliance.requirement: Proposer must protect the County from claims involving infringements of patents and/or copyrights.
compliance.evidence: Nimbus indemnifies customers against third-party intellectual property infringement claims.

compliance.requirement: Proposer must notify the County at least 180 days in advance of requesting a price change in an extension period.
compliance.evidence: The requirement is for 180 days notice, but the company policy only provides 90 days unless approved by the CFO.

compliance.requirement: Proposer must make available all County data stored within the system, on servers, or in custody to the County within 15 days of termination or request, in a machine-readable format.
compliance.evidence: Nimbus provides a full export of customer data within 30 days, not 15 days as required.

compliance.requirement: Vendor must indemnify, defend, and hold Champaign County, Illinois, harmless from claims arising from the breach of warranties.
compliance.evidence: Nimbus provides uncapped indemnification for other matters, but it requires legal review and executive approval, which may not be guaranteed for every claim.
